import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp
from cvxpy.atoms.sum_largest import sum_largest
from cvxpy.reductions.eliminate_pwl.canonicalizers.sum_largest_canon import sum_largest_canon
from cvxpy.expressions.variable import Variable

x = Variable(6)
x.value = np.array([1.0, 10.0, 6.0, 8.0, 3.0, 9.0])
expr = sum_largest(x, 2)
obj, constraints = sum_largest_canon(expr, [x])
# obj.args[1] is the epigraph q, obj.args[0] is t
q = obj.args[1].args[1]
t = obj.args[0].args[0]

# Warm-start feasibility quantities
qv = float(np.asarray(q.value).reshape(()))
tv = np.asarray(t.value).astype(float)
viol = np.max(x.value - (tv + qv))
min_t = np.min(tv)

probe_q = qv
probe_t = tv
probe_feasibility_violation = float(viol)
probe_min_t = float(min_t)

def probe(name, value):
    # The harness will record any top-level variables prefixed with probe_
    return

probe('q', probe_q)
probe('t', probe_t)
probe('feasibility_violation', probe_feasibility_violation)
probe('min_t', probe_min_t)
